dialogues.intent: 权衡维护效率与使用条件
dialogues.question: 集中垃圾桶的方案需要怎样调整？
dialogues.answer: 保留一个靠近居民楼的小投放点，并检查清运频率。
dialogues.challenge: 为一个集中管理方案提出一个具体例外，解释谁需要它及如何避免新问题。
rows: A
One central bin area would be easier to clean than several small ones.
一个集中垃圾区会比几个小点更容易清理。
B
It would, but the proposed area is uphill from the older residents' block.
是，但拟选位置在老年居民楼上坡处。
A
Could people use smaller bags to make the walk easier?
用小一点的袋子能让走路轻松些吗？
B
That might mean more trips. The difficulty isn't only the weight.
那可能意味着走更多次。困难不只是重量。
A
Perhaps we should retain a small collection point beside that block.
也许应该在那栋楼旁保留一个小投放点。
B
Yes, as long as it is emptied often enough and doesn't block the pavement.
可以，只要清运足够及时，也不挡人行道。
A
We'll compare maintenance needs and speak to residents before removing existing bins.
移除现有垃圾桶前，我们会比较维护需求并询问居民。
B
Then the decision can account for convenience on both sides of the service.
这样决定就能考虑服务双方的便利。

dialogues.title: 预约少了是没人需要吗
dialogues.scene: 乡镇居民讨论预约巴士的电话服务
dialogues.intent: 区分需求变化与参与障碍
dialogues.question: 为什么一些居民不再预约？
dialogues.answer: 电话等待太久，线上表格又难使用。
dialogues.challenge: 使用次数下降时，解释两种不同原因，提出一种了解退出者的办法。
rows: A
Bookings fell after we moved requests online. Did travel needs really decrease?
改为线上申请后预约减少了。出行需求真的减少了吗？
B
Some neighbors told me they stopped trying because the form was confusing.
邻居说表格难懂，所以他们不再尝试。
A
They can still phone, although the line is often busy in the morning.
他们仍能打电话，不过早上常占线。
B
Then both routes may be difficult. We should ask people who no longer book.
那两种渠道可能都难。应该问已经不预约的人。
A
Could we offer a callback option rather than asking them to keep waiting?
能否提供回拨选项，而不是让他们一直等？
B
That would help if staff call before the booking deadline.
如果工作人员在预约截止前回拨，就有帮助。
A
We'll test it and record unsuccessful requests too.
我们会试行，也记录没成功的申请。
B
Good. Completed bookings alone hide the journeys people wanted but couldn't arrange.
好。只看完成的预约，会漏掉想出行却安排不了的行程。

dialogues.title: 不固定班次如何预约
dialogues.scene: 居民与交通协调员商量灵活返程
dialogues.intent: 提出具体的制度调整及其限制
dialogues.question: 他们准备试什么返程安排？
dialogues.answer: 提供一个较晚的固定返程时间，并允许当天确认座位。
dialogues.challenge: 一项服务要求提前确定，但你的时间会变化。解释实际情况，并提出可控的灵活办法。
rows: A
I can book the morning bus, but my work finish time changes each day.
早上公交可以预约，但我每天结束工作的时间会变。
B
The return service currently requires booking the day before.
返程现在要求前一天预约。
A
That means I sometimes pay for a seat I can't use.
这意味着有时付钱订了座位却用不了。
B
We need enough notice to plan the route, but perhaps one later return could be fixed.
规划路线需要提前通知，不过也许能固定一班更晚的返程。
A
Could people confirm a seat that afternoon if space remains?
如果有空位，人们能当天下午确认吗？
B
We could trial that, with a clear cutoff and no guarantee after seats fill.
可以试行，设明确截止时间，满座后不保证。
A
Please explain those limits plainly so people don't depend on an unavailable trip.
请把限制说明白，避免人们依赖一趟没有座位的车。
B
Agreed. Flexibility needs reliable information as well as extra options.
同意。灵活性除了更多选择，也需要可靠信息。

dialogues.title: 软件看不到接孩子的时间
dialogues.scene: 餐厅员工与经理修改排班约束
dialogues.intent: 区分自动建议与完整现实条件
dialogues.question: Mia 希望排班系统增加什么约束？
dialogues.answer: 星期三必须五点前结束，以及不要连续安排所有周末班。
dialogues.challenge: 一个自动安排忽略了你的现实限制。说明两个具体条件，并提出人工复核办法。
rows: A
The new schedule gives me Wednesday evenings again, although I need to collect my child.
新排班又给我排了星期三晚上，但我需要接孩子。
B
Your preference was entered, but the software treats it as optional rather than a fixed limit.
你的偏好录入了，但软件把它当可选项，不是固定限制。
A
Then it doesn't represent my availability. I must finish before five on Wednesdays.
那就没有反映我的可用时间。我星期三必须五点前结束。
B
I'll change that setting and review the suggested schedule before publishing it.
我会改设置，发布前审查建议的排班。
A
Could we also look across several weeks? I've had every weekend shift this month.
还能跨几周一起看吗？这个月每个周末班都有我。
B
Yes. One week may look balanced while the repeated pattern isn't.
可以。单周可能看起来平衡，重复的模式却不平衡。
A
Please let staff check their own limits before the final version is approved.
最终批准前，请让员工检查自己的限制是否正确。
B
Agreed. Automation can help organize shifts, but we remain responsible for the arrangement.
同意。自动化可以帮助排班，但安排仍由我们负责。

dialogues.title: 自动路线没算休息
dialogues.scene: 配送员与主管讨论路线规划
dialogues.intent: 分析效率建议中遗漏的条件
dialogues.question: 为什么最短路线未必能按计划完成？
dialogues.answer: 没有计算休息、等电梯和实际卸货时间。
dialogues.challenge: 评估一个看起来节省时间的计划，指出两项被漏掉的真实步骤，并提出验证方法。
rows: A
The route planner says I can finish by three, but yesterday I was still delivering at five.
路线软件说三点能完成，但昨天五点我还在送。
B
Were there unexpected road delays?
路上有意外延误吗？
A
Some, but it also leaves no time for breaks or waiting for lifts in tall buildings.
有一些，但也没留休息或在高楼等电梯的时间。
B
Then the travel estimate is being used as if it were the complete working time.
那就是把行车估计时间当成了完整工作时间。
A
Exactly. Could we record actual unloading times for a few representative buildings?
对。能否记录几个有代表性楼宇的实际卸货时间？
B
Yes, without asking drivers to hurry just to match the estimate.
可以，也不会让司机为了符合估计而赶时间。
A
We'll need a way to report unrealistic routes before leaving the depot.
还需要在离开仓库前报告不现实路线的办法。
B
I'll add a review step. A shorter route isn't a workable schedule by itself.
我会增加审查环节。路线更短，本身不等于排程可行。

dialogues.title: 履历空档不等于能力空白
dialogues.scene: 招聘人员检查自动筛选结果
dialogues.intent: 检验筛选代理指标与工作能力的关系
dialogues.question: 一位申请者的空档实际上是什么？
dialogues.answer: 照顾家人期间，也持续参加了线上项目。
dialogues.challenge: 指出一个容易误判能力的履历信息，提出与实际岗位更相关的判断方式。
rows: A
The tool rejected this applicant because she had a two-year employment gap.
工具因为两年的工作空档拒绝了这位申请者。
B
Does the gap tell us whether she can perform the current role?
空档能告诉我们她能否胜任现在的岗位吗？
A
Not directly. She was caring for a relative and completed several online projects.
不能直接说明。她在照顾亲人，同时完成了几个线上项目。
B
Then we should examine the relevant work rather than treating uninterrupted employment as a skill.
那应该查看相关作品，而不是把连续就业当成一种技能。
A
Would a practical task help us compare applicants more consistently?
实践任务能帮助我们更一致地比较申请者吗？
B
Yes, if it's relevant, limited in scope, and assessed using the same clear criteria.
能，前提是任务相关、范围有限，而且使用同样清楚的标准。
A
We'll also review similar rejections to see whether this pattern affected other candidates.
也会检查类似拒绝，看看其他人是否受到同一模式影响。
B
Good. Correcting one case doesn't tell us whether the screening rule itself needs changing.
好。纠正一个案例，还不能说明筛选规则本身是否需要改变。

dialogues.title: 客服评分只看通话长度
dialogues.scene: 员工与主管审查自动绩效评分
dialogues.intent: 讨论单一指标带来的行为影响
dialogues.question: 长通话为什么有时是好表现？
dialogues.answer: 可能是在帮助遇到复杂问题的客户，避免他们反复来电。
dialogues.challenge: 选一个工作或学习指标，说明它测到了什么、遗漏了什么，以及怎样补充。
rows: A
My score fell because my average call was longer, but several customers had complex problems.
平均通话变长让我的分数下降，但几位客户的问题很复杂。
B
The system rewards short calls because it assumes they indicate efficiency.
系统奖励短通话，因为它假设那代表效率。
A
A quick call that doesn't solve anything may lead to three more calls later.
一次没解决问题的短通话，可能导致后来再打三次。
B
You're right. We should look at repeat contacts and whether the issue was resolved.
你说得对。应该看重复联系和问题是否解决。
A
Could reviewers also listen to a sample instead of relying only on a number?
评审还能否抽听一部分，而不只依赖数字？
B
Yes, with shared criteria so reviews don't become personal impressions.
可以，用共同标准，避免审查变成个人印象。
A
That would make it easier to explain why some calls reasonably take longer.
这样更容易解释为什么有些通话合理地需要更久。
B
We'll revise the score before using it for decisions about staff.
用分数作员工决定前，我们会先修改评分。

dialogues.title: 新机器来了旧培训没变
dialogues.scene: 工厂员工讨论转岗培训的实际内容
dialogues.intent: 把培训内容与新职责对应
dialogues.question: Mia 希望增加哪种练习？
dialogues.answer: 在安全的练习机上识别故障并按流程报告。
dialogues.challenge: 一个培训只介绍功能却没教实际操作。说明你会承担的新任务，并请求相应练习。
rows: A
The session showed how the robot moves boxes, but my new role is to identify faults.
课程展示了机器人怎么搬箱子，但我的新职责是识别故障。
B
Did it cover the warning lights and reporting procedure?
讲了警示灯和报告流程吗？
A
Only briefly. We didn't practice deciding when to stop and call a technician.
只简单讲了。没有练什么时候该停止并叫技术人员。
B
Then watching a demonstration isn't enough preparation for that responsibility.
那只看演示不足以准备承担这个责任。
A
Could we use a safe practice unit with a few simulated faults?
能用一台安全练习机，模拟几个故障吗？
B
Yes. We'll provide supervised practice and a clear guide before anyone works alone.
可以。任何人独立工作前，都会提供指导练习和清楚指南。
A
Please include time to ask questions rather than adding training after our shifts.
请留出提问时间，不要把培训加在下班之后。
B
Agreed. Training should be part of the transition, with time and support assigned.
同意。培训应是转岗的一部分，要安排时间和支持。

dialogues.title: 收银变成帮助使用自助机
dialogues.scene: 商店员工与主管讨论新职责
dialogues.intent: 识别自动化后仍需的人际技能
dialogues.question: 新培训除了机器操作还要包括什么？
dialogues.answer: 怎样耐心解释、识别需要帮助的人，并处理支付失败。
dialogues.challenge: 说明技术改变后人的任务如何变化，用一个具体场景解释仍然需要的技能。
rows: A
With more self-checkouts, I'll spend less time scanning and more time helping customers.
自助收银增多后，我扫描商品少了，帮助顾客更多。
B
We've prepared a guide to the machine's controls.
我们准备了机器操作指南。
A
That helps, but some customers are embarrassed to say they can't use it.
有帮助，但有些顾客不好意思说自己不会用。
B
So staff also need to notice difficulty and offer help without making assumptions.
所以员工也需要发现困难，主动帮忙又避免想当然。
A
And explain failed payments calmly when there's a queue behind someone.
还要在后面排着队时，冷静解释支付失败。
B
Let's practice those conversations alongside the technical steps.
把这些交流和技术步骤一起练吧。
A
Could we keep a staffed checkout for people who need another option?
能为需要别的选择的人保留人工收银吗？
B
Yes. Introducing new equipment doesn't remove our responsibility to serve different customers.
能。引入新设备不会消除服务不同顾客的责任。

dialogues.title: 误报太多以后没人停
dialogues.scene: 仓库主管与安全代表分析警报
dialogues.intent: 讨论行为背后的系统条件
dialogues.question: 他们为什么先检查误报和生产要求？
dialogues.answer: 反复误报和赶进度会让员工逐渐忽视警报。
dialogues.challenge: 一种规定被频繁忽略。除了要求大家遵守，指出一个造成忽略的条件和改进办法。
rows: A
Staff kept working when the alarm sounded again. A reminder alone isn't changing that.
警报又响时员工继续工作。单靠提醒没改变这种情况。
B
How often does it sound without a genuine problem?
没有真实问题时，它多久响一次？
A
Several times a shift. People are also criticized when output falls after stopping.
一班好几次。停机导致产量下降时，他们还会被批评。
B
Then the message to stop conflicts with the pressure to keep production moving.
那停止的要求就和维持生产的压力冲突了。
A
We need to investigate false alarms and make the response procedure consistent.
需要调查误报，并让响应流程一致。
B
And make clear that following the safety procedure won't count as poor performance.
也要明确，遵守安全流程不会算表现差。
A
We'll track the cause of each alarm rather than just the number of interruptions.
我们会记录每次警报的原因，不只是中断次数。
B
Good. The goal is a warning people can trust and act on reliably.
好。目标是让人们信任警报，并可靠地采取行动。

dialogues.title: 手机提醒太多重要消息也漏了
dialogues.scene: 远程团队调整自动通知
dialogues.intent: 区分信息数量和信息有效性
dialogues.question: 团队准备怎样分级通知？
dialogues.answer: 紧急问题即时通知，常规更新放进每日汇总。
dialogues.challenge: 你收到太多提醒。把它们分成需要立即行动和可以稍后看的两组，并解释规则。
rows: A
Our project sends so many alerts that I missed the one about the broken release.
项目提醒太多，我漏掉了发布出问题的那条。
B
Could you simply check messages more often?
你能不能更频繁地查看消息？
A
That would interrupt every task without making urgent messages easier to recognize.
那会打断每个任务，却不会让紧急消息更容易识别。
B
Fair point. We should distinguish action alerts from routine updates.
有道理。应该区分需要行动的警报和日常更新。
A
Send urgent issues immediately and put ordinary changes in a daily summary.
紧急问题即时发，普通变更放每日汇总。
B
We also need to state who should respond, not notify the entire team by default.
也需要说明谁回应，不要默认通知全队。
A
Let's review missed alerts after two weeks to see if the new rules help.
两周后检查漏掉的提醒，看看新规则是否有帮助。
B
Agreed. More notifications don't necessarily create better awareness.
同意。更多提醒不一定带来更好的了解。

dialogues.title: 自动纪要把条件删了
dialogues.scene: 团队纠正供应商会议摘要
dialogues.intent: 保留承诺中的条件和责任
dialogues.question: 原型交付取决于什么？
dialogues.answer: 供应商必须在星期四前送来零件。
dialogues.challenge: 复述一项带条件的承诺，同时说明条件不满足时应该怎样更新相关人员。
rows: A
The summary says we'll deliver the prototype on Friday, but that wasn't an unconditional promise.
摘要说我们星期五交原型，但那不是无条件的承诺。
B
What condition did it leave out?
它漏掉了什么条件？
A
We need the supplier's parts by Thursday. Otherwise assembly won't finish in time.
需要星期四前收到供应商零件，否则来不及组装。
B
Let's check the recording before changing the shared notes.
修改共享纪要前，先核对录音。
A
Here it is. I also said I'd update the client if the delivery date changed.
就在这里。我还说如果到货日期变了，会更新客户。
B
We'll restore both points and ask attendees to confirm the correction.
我们会恢复这两点，并请参会者确认更正。
A
Please send it to the client too. They may already be planning around Friday.
也请发给客户。他们可能已经按星期五在安排。
B
Yes. An accurate internal note isn't enough if the earlier version was shared outside.
对。如果旧版已对外分享，只内部准确还不够。

dialogues.title: 翻译把建议变成批准
dialogues.scene: 跨语言团队核实自动翻译
dialogues.intent: 检查关键语气并澄清决策状态
dialogues.question: 原消息表达的是批准吗？
dialogues.answer: 不是，只是说方案值得考虑，仍需财务审核。
dialogues.challenge: 有人把你的建议理解成决定。澄清目前状态、尚需的步骤，以及谁有权批准。
rows: A
The translation says the budget is approved, but the original message only says it's worth considering.
译文说预算已批准，但原消息只是说值得考虑。
B
That's a significant difference. Have any purchases been made based on it?
这差别很大。有人据此采购了吗？
A
Not yet, but the team is preparing orders. We should clarify immediately.
还没有，但团队在准备订单。应该马上澄清。
B
What review is still required?
还需要什么审核？
A
Finance must check the cost, and the director has to give final approval.
财务要核查费用，负责人要最终批准。
B
I'll send that sequence explicitly and mark the earlier translation as incorrect.
我会明确发出这个顺序，并标记先前译文错误。
A
For future messages, could someone verify approval language before we act?
以后行动前，能有人核实涉及批准的措辞吗？
B
Yes. We'll prioritize decisions and commitments when reviewing automated translations.
可以。审查自动翻译时，我们会优先检查决定和承诺。

dialogues.title: 标题说提高记忆研究却没测
dialogues.scene: 编辑与记者核对学习研究的报道
dialogues.intent: 区分研究结果和扩大后的结论
dialogues.question: 研究实际上测量了什么？
dialogues.answer: 讲座后立即进行的测验，没有测试长期记忆。
dialogues.challenge: 别人用一个短期结果说明长期效果。解释证据支持到哪里，还需要什么后续观察。
rows: A
The headline says this method improves memory, but the paper only reports an immediate quiz.
标题说这个方法提高记忆，但论文只报告了即时测验。
B
Did the researchers test the students again after a few weeks?
研究者几周后又测试学生了吗？
A
No. They measured answers directly after the lecture, in one class.
没有。他们只在一个班测了讲座后立即作答的情况。
B
Then we can't turn that result into a claim about long-term learning.
那不能把这个结果变成长期学习效果的结论。
A
We could say it was linked to better performance on that particular quiz.
可以说它与那次特定测验中更好的表现相关。
B
Yes, and explain the sample and the timing, so readers can judge the scope.
对，再说明样本和测试时间，让读者判断适用范围。
A
I'll also ask the researcher what evidence would be needed for a stronger conclusion.
我也会问研究者，更强的结论需要什么证据。
B
Good. A clear limitation makes the report more informative, not less interesting.
好。清楚的局限会让报道更有信息价值，不会让它更无趣。

dialogues.title: 少数评论变成所有用户
dialogues.scene: 同事讨论产品宣传中的证据
dialogues.intent: 辨别样本与普遍结论之间的距离
dialogues.question: 五条好评不能说明什么？
dialogues.answer: 不能说明所有用户都满意，也不能说明比例。
dialogues.challenge: 看到“人人都喜欢”这样的宣传，说明你需要哪些信息才会相信它。
rows: A
The brochure says everyone loves the service, based on five positive comments.
宣传册根据五条好评说所有人都喜欢服务。
B
Were those comments selected from a larger set?
这些评论是从更多评论中挑选的吗？
A
Yes, but we don't know how many users gave negative feedback or no feedback.
是，但不知道有多少用户给差评或没有反馈。
B
Then the comments illustrate some experiences, not the overall level of satisfaction.
那评论只是展示某些经历，不能说明整体满意度。
A
Could we quote the experiences without claiming they represent everyone?
能引用这些经历，而不声称它们代表所有人吗？
B
Certainly. For a percentage, we'd need a defined survey and a clear response count.
当然。要给百分比，需要明确的调查和清楚的回应人数。
A
I'll change the wording and ask how the feedback was collected.
我会改措辞，并询问反馈怎么收集。
B
That lets readers separate a useful example from a broad claim.
这样读者能区分有用的例子和广泛结论。

dialogues.title: 照片是真的日期不对
dialogues.scene: 志愿者核查群聊里的暴雨照片
dialogues.intent: 区分已核实事实与尚不确定内容
dialogues.question: 已经可以确认什么？
dialogues.answer: 照片至少去年就存在，不能证明今天当地的灾情。
dialogues.challenge: 向群聊解释一条信息的核查进度，分别说出已知、未知和暂时不该下的结论。
rows: A
I found this flood photo in an article from last year, so today's caption is misleading.
我在去年的文章里找到这张洪水照片，所以今天的配文有误导性。
B
Can we tell the group the image is fake?
能在群里说图片是假的吗？
A
Not exactly. The image may be genuine; we know it isn't evidence of today's local flooding.
不能这样说。图可能是真实的；我们知道它不能证明今天本地的洪水。
B
Have we confirmed where the original photo was taken?
确认原照片在哪里拍的吗？
A
The older article names a different town, but I'll check its source too.
旧文章写的是另一座镇，不过我也会检查它的来源。
B
Meanwhile, we should stop people forwarding the current caption as confirmed news.
同时，应该阻止大家把现在的配文当已确认新闻转发。
A
I'll share the older article and clearly state what we have and haven't verified.
我会分享旧文章，写清已经和还没核实的内容。
B
Good. We can correct the misuse without inventing a stronger conclusion.
好。可以纠正误用，不必编出更强的结论。

dialogues.title: 声音像本人也未必是本人
dialogues.scene: 朋友核查突然出现的语音消息
dialogues.intent: 核实来源而非凭表面相似度判断
dialogues.question: 他们准备用什么方式确认请求？
dialogues.answer: 通过已保存的原号码给朋友打电话。
dialogues.challenge: 收到熟人名义发来的异常请求，说明哪些地方让你怀疑，并选择独立的确认渠道。
rows: A
This message sounds like Sam, but it asks me to send money to a new account.
这段消息听起来像 Sam，但让我把钱转到一个新账户。
B
Did it come from the number you normally use to contact him?
来自你平常联系他的号码吗？
A
No. It claims his phone is broken and says not to call.
不是。它说手机坏了，还叫我别打电话。
B
The voice alone isn't enough to verify the request. Can you contact him independently?
光声音不足以核实请求。能用独立渠道联系他吗？
A
I'll call his saved number, rather than any number in this message.
我会拨已保存的号码，不用这段消息里的号码。
B
Good. If he doesn't answer, wait and try another trusted contact.
好。如果他不接，先等一等，再联系另一个可信的人。
A
I won't forward the recording as proof that he's in trouble.
我也不会把录音当成他遇到麻烦的证据转发。
B
Exactly. Verify the identity and situation before treating the request as genuine.
对。把请求当真之前，先核实身份和情况。

dialogues.title: 网上投票不能代表全社区
dialogues.scene: 记者与居民解读停车场投票
dialogues.intent: 区分意见规模与具体意见价值
dialogues.question: 投票可以提供什么有用信息？
dialogues.answer: 参与者的具体顾虑，但不能可靠估计全社区支持比例。
dialogues.challenge: 一个开放投票有很多回应。解释人数多为什么仍不代表所有人，并指出可保留的价值。
rows: A
Seventy percent voted against the car park, but the link was shared mainly in one campaign group.
七成反对停车场，但链接主要在一个倡议群里分享。
B
So the result may reflect who saw the link and chose to participate.
所以结果可能反映的是谁看到了链接并愿意参与。
A
Should we leave it out of the article completely?
应该把它完全从文章里删掉吗？
B
No. Some comments identify real concerns, like losing shade near the playground.
不用。有些评论指出真实问题，比如游乐场旁边少了遮阴。
A
We can report those concerns without presenting the percentage as the whole community's view.
可以报道这些顾虑，而不把比例当成全社区观点。
B
Exactly. Explain how responses were gathered and who may not have been reached.
对。说明回应如何收集，以及可能没触达谁。
A
I'll seek views from nearby residents who aren't in the online group.
我会寻求不在这个网上群里的附近居民的意见。
B
Then the story can show the range of experiences without overstating what the poll proves.
这样报道能展示不同经历，同时不夸大投票证明的内容。

dialogues.title: 扫码反馈遗漏老人
dialogues.scene: 社区工作人员讨论服务满意调查
dialogues.intent: 检查反馈渠道的覆盖范围
dialogues.question: 他们准备增加哪些反馈方式？
dialogues.answer: 纸质短问卷和现场口头反馈。
dialogues.challenge: 设计一个小调查，说明谁可能不会回应，以及你如何让他们也能表达。
rows: A
Almost every online response praises the new center, yet several older visitors told me they're unhappy.
几乎每条线上回应都夸新中心，可几位年长访客跟我说不满意。
B
How did they access the survey?
他们怎么进入调查？
A
They didn't. The poster only has a QR code, and some don't use smartphones.
他们没参加。海报只有二维码，有些人不用智能手机。
B
Then the positive results may partly reflect who could respond, not only service quality.
那积极结果可能部分反映谁能回应，不只是服务质量。
A
Let's offer a short paper version and a chance to give feedback at reception.
提供简短纸质版，也允许在前台反馈吧。
B
We should keep the questions comparable and let people answer without staff watching closely.
题目应可比较，也要让人不用在工作人员盯着时回答。
A
And report the different collection methods when we share the findings.
分享结果时，也说明不同的收集方式。
B
Agreed. A wider route to feedback may reveal needs the first survey missed.
同意。更广的反馈途径可能发现第一次调查漏掉的需求。

dialogues.title: 赞助关系说明了什么
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论耳机测评的商业披露
dialogues.intent: 区分潜在激励与具体事实的真伪
dialogues.question: 有赞助是否证明测评全是假的？
dialogues.answer: 不是，但需要检查测试方式、对比条件和其他证据。
dialogues.challenge: 评价一篇有商业关系的测评，分别说明利益关系、可核实事实和个人偏好。
rows: A
The reviewer received the headphones for free. Does that mean we should ignore the whole video?
测评者免费拿到了耳机。这意味着整段视频都该忽略吗？
B
It creates a possible incentive, but it doesn't prove every statement is false.
这会产生潜在激励，但不能证明每句话都是假的。
A
He says the battery lasted thirty hours. That sounds testable.
他说电池用了三十小时。这听起来可以测试。
B
Yes. Check the volume and settings, then compare with another independent test.
对。查看音量和设置，再和另一次独立测试比较。
A
His claim that they're 'the most comfortable' is more personal.
他称它们“最舒服”就更主观了。
B
Exactly. His head shape and how long he wore them matter.
对。他的头型和佩戴时间都有影响。
A
I'll use the video as one source, not as a complete reason to buy.
我会把视频当一个来源，不当成购买的全部理由。
B
And try them yourself if possible. Disclosure helps you interpret evidence, not replace it.
能试的话也自己试。披露帮助理解证据，不能代替证据。

dialogues.title: 优惠链接背后的推荐
dialogues.scene: 朋友审视旅游博主的酒店推荐
dialogues.intent: 核实推荐依据与个人需求
dialogues.question: Mia 还需要查看什么？
dialogues.answer: 近期住客评论、自己的日期价格和实际交通条件。
dialogues.challenge: 解释为什么一个热门推荐可能不适合你，用自己的两项需求重新判断。
rows: A
The blogger calls this hotel the best choice, and the booking link gives her a commission.
博主说这家酒店是最佳选择，通过预订链接她能得到佣金。
B
Did she stay there herself, and does she explain what she compared?
她自己住过吗，也说明比较了什么吗？
A
She stayed for one night, but her visit was outside the busy season.
住过一晚，不过是在淡季。
B
Your trip is in summer, so both the price and crowding could be different.
你夏天去，价格和拥挤情况都可能不同。
A
I also need to get to the station early. She mostly stayed by the pool.
我还得很早去车站。她主要待在泳池边。
B
Then check recent guest comments and the actual transport options for your dates.
那查看近期住客评论，以及你日期下的实际交通选择。
A
The recommendation may be honest without being the right recommendation for me.
推荐可能很诚实，却未必是适合我的推荐。
B
Exactly. Commercial context and personal fit are separate questions to examine.
对。商业背景和是否适合自己，是需要分别检查的问题。

dialogues.title: 改正文还要通知旧读者
dialogues.scene: 编辑与记者拟定公开更正
dialogues.intent: 明确错误范围并修复传播后的理解
dialogues.question: 更正除了正文还要覆盖哪里？
dialogues.answer: 标题、社交媒体帖子和已经收到报道的订阅者。
dialogues.challenge: 你公开分享了一条后来发现不准确的信息。说明错在哪里、正确事实和你将更新哪些地方。
rows: A
I've corrected the number in the article, but the old headline is still on social media.
我改了文章里的数字，但社交媒体上还是旧标题。
B
Did the wrong number affect the conclusion, or was it only a minor detail?
错误数字影响了结论，还是只是小细节？
A
It affected the conclusion. We said the program had doubled attendance, which isn't supported.
影响了。我们说项目让参加人数翻倍，这并没有依据。
B
Then the correction must explain the changed conclusion, not merely replace one figure.
那更正必须解释结论变化，而不只是替换数字。
A
I'll update the headline, add a visible note, and correct the social posts.
我会更新标题、加明显说明，并更正社交帖子。
B
Notify subscribers too, because they may never return to the page.
也通知订阅者，因为他们可能永远不会回到页面。
A
Should we explain how the mistake happened?
需要解释错误怎么发生的吗？
B
Briefly and clearly, along with what we've verified and how we'll prevent a repeat.
简短清楚地解释，再说明已核实的内容和如何避免重犯。

dialogues.title: 群里转发错了活动时间
dialogues.scene: 社区组织者更正已传播的通知
dialogues.intent: 承担错误并确认更正触达
dialogues.question: 他们怎样避免居民白跑一趟？
dialogues.answer: 更正群公告、联系转发者，并在旧海报位置放说明。
dialogues.challenge: 你发错了一项活动信息。写出或说出一条清楚的更正，让没看过原消息的人也能理解。
rows: A
I posted that the workshop starts at six, but the confirmed time is seven.
我发了工作坊六点开始，但确认的时间是七点。
B
How widely has the notice been shared?
通知被分享得多广？
A
Three neighborhood groups, plus the poster at the library. I've edited my original message.
三个社区群，还有图书馆海报。我已经改了原消息。
B
People may have saved the old version. Send a new correction rather than relying on the edit.
大家可能存了旧版。应发新的更正，不要只依靠编辑。
A
I'll state the date, the correct time, and that my earlier notice was wrong.
我会写日期、正确时间，也明确说先前通知有误。
B
Ask the people who forwarded it to share the correction, and replace the library poster.
请转发的人分享更正，并更换图书馆海报。
A
Could someone be at the venue at six in case anyone still arrives early?
能有人六点在场吗，以防还是有人早到？
B
Yes. Correcting the information should also reduce the inconvenience it has already caused.
能。更正信息也应该减少已经造成的不便。
